messages.author: 1f2aec04959ef119
messages.subject: Warning: Error in .local: not a valid subset
parts:
Hi all
I have a shiny app that animates a raster stack on a leaflet() map and seems to be failing for a reason I can't interpret.    

In the log I see Warning: Error in .local: not a valid subset.  The app turns gray at this error.  The raster stack is over 200 rasters, one for each day of year and the animation plays by day of year.  New to shiny and no clue what is happening.  Any one ever had this Warning/Error?
Thanks.
